messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Knitr does not work in TexMaker

Hi Glenn,

Is this in any way specific to knitr?  El Capitan changed the location of files and some paths that broke a number of TeX distributions, AFAIK, and at least on one Mac I used basically no terminal-based usage of TeX worked after the upgrade.  Once symlinks and paths were fixed so that latex and pdflatex worked from the terminal, then things worked again.

I could be wrong as I'm not familiar with TexMaker specifically, but knitr normally just sends commands to a terminal to run (pdf)latex, so I'm not sure what you're having is a knitr specific problem.  

Cheers,

Josh
